description: Held-out set for POST /v1/topics/resolve against the 150 seed topics. Written 22 Oct 2026 by the credit-sprint session and NOT used to tune A6 (test/fixtures/catalog/golden.json was the tuning set; no phrase here appears there, and most topics here were never probed by it). Same case shape and scoring as the golden set: 'topic' is strict-correct when the slug is auto-matched and lenient-correct when it is matched or offered among the choices; 'choices' is correct when the result is choices, or a match within the listed slugs; 'new' is correct when a topic is created. 'kind' groups the cases: paraphrase (in-catalog topic in a learner's own words), sibling (a parent or sibling topic is close by; only the listed slug is right), near-miss (out of catalog, but close in wording or field to 'nearSlugs'; auto-matching any of them is a wrong match, choices is a soft miss), out-of-catalog (clearly new) and ambiguous (several catalog topics fit). Run it once per threshold or embedding change and report it separately from the tuning set; don't tune against it.
